perspective:
Jose Castillo’s available information:

- He noticed Patricia seemed more withdrawn/down than usual at work and asked if she was okay.
- Patricia told him it was “nothing really,” just “personal stuff,” and thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk; she said she appreciated it.
- He later overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He brought up financial planning, saying he’d been reading about it, and offered to discuss it with her.
- Patricia said that could be helpful and that she’d been overwhelmed with bills lately.
- He offered to look over budgeting tips together; Patricia thanked him and said she’d take him up on it soon.
- He worried he might have overstepped by bringing up finances, so he checked in with her about it.
- Patricia told him she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful for his offer.
- He told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend; Patricia said she appreciated having someone to turn to.
- Later, he asked about her weekend; Patricia said she was fine and planning a quiet weekend at home, then asked about his plans.
- He said he planned to read/relax and reminded her he was available if she needed anything or wanted to chat; she thanked him and said she’d keep it in mind.
- He continued checking in with her at work and offered help, even just getting coffee; Patricia said she was busy but handling it, appreciated his support, and said it was great to have his support.
- He responded that they were all there to help each other.
